description: Kind 15 records around the cap of the kind (69,760 bytes) and the envelope limit of plaintext kind 5 (69,632 bytes). Every record is {1: 1, 2: 15, 3: 5, 4: hash, 5: envelope}; the envelope is opaque to the reader and is the affine-7-3 pattern of envelope_size bytes.

cases.description: Kind 15, plaintext kind 5, envelope of 69,632 bytes (the limit of plaintext kind 5): 69,680 bytes, the largest kind 15 record any reader accepts.

reject.description: Kind 15, plaintext kind 5, envelope of 69,633 bytes: 69,681 bytes, under the cap, refused by the envelope limit.
Kind 15, plaintext kind 5, exactly 69,760 bytes (envelope 69,712): the cap is inclusive, so the size passes and the envelope limit refuses.
Kind 15, plaintext kind 5, 69,761 bytes (envelope 69,713), well formed: the cap of the kind refuses it before the envelope limit is checked.
